title: Privacy & Cookies
description: What data AI Porn Bible collects and how it's used.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
We use privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics to count page views and clicks to listed platforms. It doesn't use cookies, doesn't build profiles of individual visitors, and doesn't track you across other sites.

If you email us, we keep your email and message to reply to you.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site doesn't set advertising or tracking cookies, so there is nothing to opt out of. If that changes, a cookie settings control will appear here.

sections.heading: Outbound links
sections.body: When you click through to a platform, that platform's own privacy policy applies. Affiliate links may carry a tracking parameter so the platform knows you came from us.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: To ask about or delete any data we hold about you, email hello@aipornbible.com.
